# v0.11.1 verification

Run the ordered build through release_v111.py, build_standalone.py, then checks.mjs, checks_v111.mjs, checks_interface.mjs and checks_calculator.mjs. Checks cover preserved populated regimens, selected high-consequence renal thresholds and units, provenance/version/hash metadata, empty-field honesty, search, embedded documents, manual theme/font/back controls, calculator arithmetic/privacy and actual worker offline/update/cache isolation. Fresh package reconstruction and root checksums validate cumulative/delta equivalence. Browser QA checks the centred name and compact controls at narrow phone sizes and enlarged text.

These software checks do not establish clinical validity. Independent approval, full local product/BNF review, and physical-phone hosted HTTPS installation/update checks remain pending.
